title: sieve: error types (ParseError, EvalError)
description: Define error types in crates/sieve/src/error.rs. ParseError { line: usize, col: usize, kind: ParseErrorKind } where ParseErrorKind covers: UnexpectedToken(String), UnexpectedEof, UnknownCommand(String), UnknownExtension(String), DuplicateRequire, RequireAfterCommand, InvalidArgument(String), IntegerOverflow, UnclosedString, InvalidMultilineEnd. EvalError covers: UndeclaredExtension(String), InvalidMatchType, InvalidAddressPart, InvalidComparator, InternalError(String). Both implement std::error::Error and Display. Constructors: ParseError::at(line, col, kind) and EvalError::undeclared(ext).
